headline: Executive order directs federal action to end cashless bail and step up law enforcement in Washington, D.C.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs federal steps aimed at ending cashless bail in the District of Columbia, meaning people arrested would not be released before trial without posting bail. It also calls for stronger enforcement of the law in D.C. No official summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies involved, and legal methods are not clear from the available information.

who_it_affects.how: They may be more likely to be held in jail or required to pay bail before trial instead of being released without paying.
They may see more law enforcement activity in the city.

who_it_affects.group: Federal and D.C. law enforcement, prosecutors, and courts
who_it_affects.how: They may be directed to change how they handle arrests, charges, and pretrial release in D.C.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 25, 2025; the specific effective dates of any changes are not stated in the available information.
